retained_low_severity_limits: Faulting/non-numeric injected clocks and custom objects whose deepcopy raises can escape as raw exceptions; these fail closed. Native owner must use standard monotonic clock and canonical JSON-derived cases and treat any exception as abort.
A whole receipt includes raw bytes, not directly JSON serializable. Scalar sidecars/decoded views are serializable.
Time budget is cooperative and payload budget does not measure process memory. Native owner must enforce external hard timeout/storage bounds.
Identity and hook flags remain injected assertions, not native provenance. Activity flags describe module-only behavior, excluding callbacks.
